Shri Harsh Jain - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri C.M. Tiwari - Government Advocate for the State.

Order 
This is the first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant/accused under Section 482 of BNSS,
2023 for grant of anticipatory bail, as he is under apprehension of his arrest, in connection with Crime No.1324/2021, registered at Police Station Kolar Road, District Bhopal (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 120-B and 34 of IPC and Section 66-D of IT Act.

entities.text: Police Station Kolar Road, District Bhopal

sentences.text: 2. As per prosecution story, it is alleged that applicant along with other co-accused persons committed fraud with the complainant.
Therefore, the aforesaid offence has been registered against the applicant.
3. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated.
It is submitted that compromise has been taken place between the complainant and other co- accused persons.
Co-accused persons have been enlarged on bail.
There is no NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-JBP:272 2 MCRC-59965-2025 need of custodial interrogation.
In these circumstances, applicant may be granted anticipatory bail.
4. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant on the ground that amount has been received in the account of the applicant.
Applicant has actively participated in the crime.
It is further submitted that co-accused persons have been enlarged on regular bail whereas the applicant has filed an application for grant of anticipatory bail.
Applicant is absconding since long and investigation qua the applicant is incomplete and, therefore, custodial interrogation is required from the applicant.
5. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case and seriousness of offence, I am not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the applicant.
